facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Dorothy wanted to go home. The Wizard could not help her. A good witch helped her. Home is the best.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Dorothy's friends all got what they needed at last. Now it was Dorothy's turn to get help from the Wizard. But the Wizard admitted he was not really magical at all. Home is the best place in the world, Dorothy believed. The good witch told her to click her silver shoes together. Dorothy closed her eyes and wished to go home.
facts.Word cards: home = 집 / best = 최고의 / place = 장소 / heart = 마음
